sources.text: While fighting alongside a Coalition of Planets ally, Thaedus gains 1 Charge every 15 seconds.
If there is a Technologist on the team, they receive a 15% energy attack boost and a 6% cooldown reduction.
Viltrumite allies deal 7% additional damage with their attacks when General Kregg is present in battle.
When an ally is defeated, General Kregg charges the main skill of the ally with the highest attack by 30%, and forces them to target the enemy that dealt the finishing blow.
Robot gains a 4% attack boost for each "Last Line of Defense" ally on the team.
sources.payoff: +4% per Last Line of Defense ally attack

sources.text: When fighting alongside a "Human", Capevincible increases his life leech by 8%.
While fighting with a Last Line of Defense ally, the team's ability cooldown is reduced by 5%.
When an ally receives any shield, the value of the shield is increased by 5%.
Monster Girl increases the defense of "Guardians of the Globe" allies by 5.5% of her HP.
Rae increases human allies' defense by 5% for each Guardian Of The Globe in the team.
sources.payoff: +5% per The Guardians of the Globe ally defense

sources.text: If there's any human on the team, Bulletproof decreases the damage received from ranged enemies by 5%.
War Woman increases her team's attack by 3% for each original Guardians of the Globe present in her team.
sources.payoff: +3% per The Original Guardians of the Globe ally attack

sources.text: Green Ghost increases the max HP by 1% for each member of the original Guardians of the Globe in her team.
sources.payoff: +1% per The Original Guardians of the Globe ally maxHp

sources.text: Increases the team's energy attack by 4% and their energy defense by 4% for each mauler on the team (excluding self).
Increases the team's physical attack by 4% and their physical defense by 4% for each mauler on the team (excluding self).
Angstrom Levy acquires the Mauler Twins' tag during the battle and increases the charge speed of the Mauler Twins' allies main abilities by 8%.
Thula increases her attack by 50% for 5 seconds every time an ally or enemy Viltrumite dies in the battle.

Every 20 seconds, Thula and Lucan attack the target with less HP using a combined movement that deals 200% damage and stuns the enemy for 1 seconds. If Lucan is in the same team, both heroes receive a 20% defence increase during 3 seconds after the attack.
Lucan increases his defence by 50% for 5 seconds every time an ally or enemy Viltrumite dies in the battle.
Whenever an enemy gets stunned, he fires 2 webs at them dealing 50% of his base attack damage. His critical damage receives a 12% boost for 3 seconds. Cooldown 2 seconds.
If there's any Last Line Of Defense Heroes in the team, the team's critical chance is increased by 5%.
When a non-summoned ally dies, Cecil summons a Reaniman to the battlefield with 30% of the ally's stats.

When an enemy is pushed by an ally, Anissa dashes towards them, flying through any enemies in the way, dealing 200% of her base attack damage, while applying a bleeding effect of 100% of her base attack damage over 5 seconds. Cooldown 10 seconds.
When there's a 'Leader' ally present in the team, Conquest increases his attack by 25% of his defence.
When fighting with a Not of this Earth ally, he boosts all team healing effects by 6% and defense by 5%.
When fighting alongside a 'Not of This Earth' character, Seance Dog's healing ability also provides shields equal to 30% of the healing amount for 20 seconds.
Iguana gains a 1% life leech increase for each Lizard League team member on her team.
When fighting alongside a "Leader", Donald increases his team's Defense by 6%.
Komodo Dragon increases his defense by 10% for each Lizard League ally on the team.
Whenever a 'Viltrumite', ally or enemy, is defeated, Nolan gains a 3% attack boost (max. 5 stacks).
When an ally from 'The Order' is defeated, the remaining allies immediately gain a 1% boost to their max HP (max. 6 stacks).
Dinosaurus increases his team's max HP by 3% if there are any Last Line of Defense allies on the team.
Thragg increases his max HP by 2% for each Viltrumite present in the battle.
Tech Jacket increases her own Energy Attack and that of all allies by 5% for each Coalition of Planets member on the team (excluding herself).
sources.payoff: +5% per Coalition of Planets ally energyAttack

sources.text: Enemies targeting the Guardians of the Globe allies receive 5% extra damage from Dupli-Kate and her copies.
When an enemy receives a critical strike, Rex Splode throws a bomb that deals 20% base damage and burns them, dealing 10% of extra base damage for 5 seconds.
he increases the enemies' ability cooldown by 5% for each original Guardian of the Globe member present on his team.
sources.payoff: +5% per The Original Guardians of the Globe ally cooldownSpeed

sources.text: When an enemy kills a Human ally, Darkwing stuns the enemy that performed the kill for 1 seconds.
Isotope increases the team's max HP by 3% for each member of "The Order" on the team.
When "The Order" is on the same team, Magmaniac reduces all enemies' max HP by 4%.
When Tether Tyrant fights alongside other characters from The Order, he increases his self-defense by 1% for 3 seconds every time an enemy or ally dies.
When an ally dies, he increases the critical chance of his allies from "Not of This Earth" by 10% for 5 seconds.
Each time a Malefactor ally dies, Multi-Paul and his copies gain a 1% life leech. (Stacks up to a maximum of 8 times).
When fighting alongside Heroes from the "Last Line of Defense", Kid Omni-Man increases his team's healing received by 5%.
Volcanikka gains 1 Charge whenever a Subsoil ally is defeated. Each Charge increases her team's damage over time by 2% (max. 10 stacks).
